svg.title: Knowledge graph of my work
svg.desc: Graph with Kiran at the root, linked to LLMs & RAG (work: KG agentic RAG, Grounded RAG, LLaMA 3 LoRA; tools: LangGraph, FAISS, LoRA, FastAPI); Vision & Multimodal (work: Retinal VLM, CLIP training, Label QC; tools: PyTorch, MedGemma, ResNet, BERT); Classical ML (work: Exoplanets, Loan models, Log triage NLP; tools: XGBoost, LightGBM, scikit-learn, Azure ML); Data & MLOps (work: PySpark ETL, Digital twin, Drift monitors; tools: PySpark, Docker, Kubernetes, MQTT).

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: neo4j$ MATCH (k:Engineer {name: "Kiran"})-[:BUILT]->(w)-[:USES]->(t) RETURN k, w, t
